rationale: This disposable CI witness reuses the canonical trust-level registry so the live workflow proves semantic mechanism resolution rather than merely structural record acceptance.
trust_boundary: The witness changes only an unmerged OpenSpec delta and introduces no runtime, authority, identity, processing, collection, delivery, or storage boundary.
transformation_ownership: No event transformation occurs; the witness author owns only the repository fixture used to exercise the existing CRA checker in pull-request CI.

alternatives.rejection_reason: The witness introduces no contract semantics and therefore has no basis for extending the canonical registry or declaring a compatibility classification.

assurance_limitations: This never-merged fixture proves only that the existing CI path executes the CRA checker with distinguishable positive and negative outcomes.
